3 WebSocket endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Feeds

### Aggregates (Per Minute)

`AM.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/indices` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/indices` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/indices/aggregates-per-minute.md)

Stream minute-by-minute aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) for a specified index via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify an index ticker using "I:" prefix or use * to subscribe to all index tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple index tickers. You can retrieve available index tickers from our Index Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym op o c h l s e`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time

### Aggregates (Per Second)

`A.<ticker>` · Delayed `wss://delayed.massive.com/indices` · Real-Time `wss://socket.massive.com/indices` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/indices/aggregates-per-second.md)

Stream second-by-second aggregated OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) for a specified index via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify an index ticker using "I:" prefix or use * to subscribe to all index tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple index tickers. You can retrieve available index tickers from our Index Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev sym op o c h l s e`
- **Plan:** Advanced+ · recency Advanced Real-time

### Value

`V.<ticker>` · Business `wss://business.massive.com/indices` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/websocket/indices/value.md)

Stream real-time index value updates for specified index tickers via WebSocket.

- **Ticker:** Specify an index ticker using "I:" prefix or use * to subscribe to all index tickers. You can also use a comma separated list to subscribe to multiple index tickers. You can retrieve available index tickers from our Index Tickers API.
- **Returns:** `ev val T t`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter 15-min delayed · Advanced Real-time
